Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Triple Glass Shade Ceiling Hanging Pendant Chandelier Fixture - 23 x 7 x 36 Inches, Gunmetal Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Metal
This smartly designed industrial pendant chandelier will add a sophisticated twist to a modern kitchen, dining room or bar area. Black metal is paired with three clear glass shades. Modern industrial Metal hardware with gunmetal black finish, clear glass shades Provides ample light along with a strong, modern style statement 36"H x "23"W x 7"D. Rods can be removed to adjust to 22"H. Product is hardwired (professional installation recommended) Intended for indoor use only
